title: Uranium at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: a modern context on Skinwalker Ranch, they say that there's like a lot of uranium around.

plain: Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, is said to have a lot of uranium in the ground around it. Michels mentions this in passing on a 2024 episode with the writer Graham Hancock, as something "they say", without saying who.
